description: DevPilot multi-language repair cases (JavaScript, Go, and a Python repo with a pip dependency). NOT part of the measured 36-case benchmark: these exist so the multi-language path can be measured, and no pass rate has been recorded for them yet. Run with: python -m eval.run_eval --benchmark benchmark_multilang.json --prompt-versions v4 (v4 resolves to the v5 prompt for non-Python repos). They need SANDBOX_BACKEND=remote against a runner that has Node and Go, or SANDBOX_BACKEND=local with node/go installed.

cases.bug: A cart with 3 items at 10 and 1 item at 5 totals 15 instead of 35; the quantity of each line is ignored.
slugify('Hello, World!') returns 'hello-world-' with a trailing dash; leading and trailing punctuation should not leave dashes.
Calling Pop on an empty Stack panics with an index out of range; it should return 0 and false.
Withdrawing more than the wallet holds succeeds and leaves a negative balance; it should return ErrInsufficientFunds and leave the balance unchanged.
settings.get raises a TypeError for a dotted path whose parent is a number, such as db.port.number; it should return the default.
